title: Selected pullback composition on localized underived counits
statement: Fix the unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. For f:X→Y, g:Y→Z and a homotopy complex K on X, let U(s) denote homotopy pushforward, b(s) the chosen tensor-pullback homotopy adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], epsilon(s) the selected left-derived counit [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and p(f,g) the selected composition comparison [lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation]. Then p(f,g) at Q(U(fg)K), followed by epsilon(fg) at U(fg)K and Q of the underived counit b(fg) at K, equals the concrete pasted morphism derivedCompositionCounitApex f g K [def-sc-derived-composition-counit-apex]. This uses no derived pullback/direct-image adjunction or right-derived unit.

source.place: Tags 079W (lemma-adjoint), 0D5S (derived pullback composition) and 0096 (module pullback adjunction); formal categorical subcalculation in parent steps 2 and 3. Official tag pages read 2026-10-14.

proof.text: For arbitrary additive adjunctions a1, a2 and a and a right-adjoint comparison e, pass to a complex representative of K. Rewrite all three homotopy counits as quotients of complex counits. Functoriality reduces the equality to chain maps, and degreewise conjugateEquiv_counit_symm a (a2.comp a1) e.inv proves the composite-counit identity. This is the private proved helper composite_counit.

The inverse of Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g is the identity on sections. Degreewise extensionality and quotient functoriality prove that its mapped homotopy component is the identity. Substitute this in composite_counit for the three pinned tensor-pullback adjunctions, removing the image of the identity.

Extract the selected IsLeftDerivedFunctor witness and the selected comparison hom equation from exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Apply the generic private proved localized_counit helper: leftDerived_fac_app replaces p followed by epsilon(fg) with the pasted counits and the localized tensor mate; substitute the underived counit identity from the previous steps. Naturality of epsilon(f) at the g-counit moves its tensor-pullback image through epsilon(f), and map_comp gives the explicit apex expression. Finish with derivedCompositionCounitApex_eq.

theorem derivedPullbackComposition_localized_counit
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    let ε {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) :=
      (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) s
    let b {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) :=
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction s)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    (canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition f g).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ≫ g)).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      (ε (f ≫ g)).app
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ≫ g)).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((b (f ≫ g)).counit.app K) =
      derivedCompositionCounitApex f g K
